t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Go for the little hats as they offer more pointsColour of the hats mean that muchIf little hats aren't offering much points go for other hats

vb_textbox.text: In my experience, the colours of the gnomes mattered little. The size of hats on the gnomes mattered the most. The smaller the gnomes hat, the better. However, the game does try to switch it up at times.I also found that the once you receive a large number of mushrooms by selecting one gnome on one side, the gnome on the other side would then also have a large amount of mushrooms.
